description_en: Elastic Desktop Service supports two account systems: convenience accounts and enterprise AD accounts. Creates an office network (formerly workspace) based on convenience accounts
description_zh: 无影云电脑支持便捷账号和企业AD账号这两种账号体系。本接口用于创建一个基于便捷账号的办公网络（原工作区）
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-simple-office-site --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cidr-block 172.16.0.0/12 --cen-id cen-3gwy16dojz1m650000 --cen-owner-id 1182725234310000 --verify-code 123456 --bandwidth 10 --office-site-name TestOfficeSite_Simple --enable-internet-access false --enable-admin-access true --desktop-access-type Internet --need-verify-zero-device true --vswitch-id vsw-bp12mw1f8k3jgy0000 --cloud-box-office-site false --vpc-type standard --account-type SIMPLE --authority-host https://login.microsoftonline.com --tenant-id 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd0110000 --domain-name domain.local --client-id a2c8f7e4-1b3d-4c5e-9f0a-6d7b8c9e0000 --client-secret sct-9f3e2d1c0000 --eid e-1234abcd0000 --access-attribute Private --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSimpleOfficeSite

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IPv4 CIDR block of the VPC for the office network. This parameter is required for advanced office networks. The system uses automatic creation of a VPC based on the specified IPv4 CIDR block. Use one of the following CIDR blocks or their subnets:

`10.0.0.0/12` (valid mask range: 12 to 24 bits)
`172.16.0.0/12` (valid mask range: 12 to 24 bits)
`192.168.0.0/16` (valid mask range: 16 to 24 bits)
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络VPC包含的IPv4网段。高级办公网络必填参数，系统将根据输入的IPv4网段，自动创建一个专有网络VPC。建议您使用以下网段及其子网作为IPv4网段：

`10.0.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
`172.16.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
`192.168.0.0/16`（掩码有效范围为16\~24位）
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

To connect to cloud desktops over a VPC connection, add the office network to a CEN instance. The CEN instance is the one that the on-premises network connects to by using a VPN or Express Connect circuit
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网CEN实例ID。

如果想要通过VPC连接的方式接入云电脑，可以将办公网络加入到云企业网实例中。该云企业网实例为本地网络通过VPN或者专线接入的云企业网实例
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the CEN instance belongs.

If CenId is not specified or the specified CEN instance belongs to the current Alibaba Cloud account, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If the specified CEN instance belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, specify the Alibaba Cloud account ID of that account
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

如果未配置CenId，或者配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。
如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The verification code. If the specified CEN instance belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/335132.html to obtain the verification code first
parameters.help_zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/335132.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

parameters.help_en:
The peak Internet bandwidth. Valid values: 10 to 200. Unit: Mbit/s.
You can specify this parameter when `EnableInternetAccess` is set to `true`
parameters.help_zh:
公网带宽峰值。取值范围：10~200。带宽单位为 Mbps。
当`EnableInternetAccess`配置为`true`时可以设置该参数
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The name of the office network. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http:/`/和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public network access
parameters.help_zh: 是否开通公网访问功能
parameters.name: enable_internet_access

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to users who use cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access

parameters.help_en:
The access method allowed when connecting to cloud desktops.

The VPC connection method depends on the Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink service, which is free of charge. If this parameter is set to `VPC` or `Any`, the system automatically activates the PrivateLink service
parameters.help_zh:
连接云电脑时允许使用的接入方式。

VPC连接方式依赖于阿里云私网连接PrivateLink服务，该服务不收取费用。该参数设置为`VPC`或者`Any`时，系统将自动为您开通私网连接服务
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable trusted device verification
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启可信设备校验
parameters.name: need_verify_zero_device

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the VPC. This parameter is required when you create a CloudBox office network
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络VPC中的交换机ID，创建云盒办公网络时需要填写
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the office network is a CloudBox office network
parameters.help_zh: 是否为云盒办公网络
parameters.name: cloud_box_office_site

parameters.help_en: The type of the office network
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络的类型
parameters.name: vpc_type

parameters.help_en: The account type
parameters.help_zh: 账号类型
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en: The authority URL of the identity authentication service
parameters.help_zh: 身份认证服务的 Authority 地址
parameters.name: authority_host

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID of the identity provider
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供方的租户 ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD的域名称
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The client ID registered with the identity provider application
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供方应用注册的客户端 ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The client secret registered with the identity provider application
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供方应用注册的客户端密钥
parameters.name: client_secret

parameters.help_en: The enterprise ID (EID)
parameters.help_zh: 企业 ID（EID）
parameters.name: eid

parameters.help_en: The access attribute of the office network (workspace)
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络（工作区）的访问属性
parameters.name: access_attribute
